name: Allow cards
why: How a thread gets a folder on your computer, and where you answer the card and each prompt
ideal: No Allow card per Mac thread: the allow list and Auto mode cover its work. Any card is answered where asked, within minutes.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Card
steps.rule: Turn on Worktree on the Allow card when another thread uses the same folder.

steps.name: Answer
steps.rule: Answer a thread's approval prompt in that thread: a go-ahead in the project conversation does not reach it.

steps.name: Count
steps.rule: Count the Allow cards and approval prompts each Mac thread raises.
